validity.recommendation: No existence/classification action needed; see attribution and spec items below for two follow-up fixes.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, active project. Independently verified: Sohu news article (2024-09-22, archived copy is the sheet's own current Status [ref]) names the '合浦-博白-浦北天然气支线管道' (Hepu-Bobai-Pubei natural gas branch pipeline) project by a Sinopec-affiliated construction team and reports directional-drilling completed 5 days ahead of schedule -> confirms active construction as of Sep 2024. Separately, web search surfaced (but I could NOT fetch/verify directly -- see caveat) four distinct Guangxi government bureaus' filings that all name this exact project: the Guangxi DRC core approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, approved 2020-06-17, matching the wiki's own cite_note-29 date), a land-use approval (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn), an EIA approval (sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn), and a water-crossing permit (slt.gxzf.gov.cn). Search-engine-cached text from the DRC approval gives project detail that matches GEM almost exactly: total length ~162km split into a Hepu-Bobai branch (~108km, dia 355.6mm) + Pubei branch (~54km, dia 273.1mm) -- GEM's LengthKnown=162.00 and Diameter='355.6, 273.1' match exactly; design capacity 9.43e8 m3/yr =~0.943 bcm/y vs GEM's 0.94 bcm/y also matches closely. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- this is a high-pressure (6.3-10 MPa) branch line feeding city-gate distribution stations off the existing Sinopec Beihai LNG trunk line, i.e. transmission-grade, not a local distribution main; Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both stand. DUPLICATE: checked against the 43-row roster -- no other row references Hepu/Pubei/162km/355.6+273.1mm combo. P7652 ('Bobai->Guangxi', 28km, cap 0.2 bcm/y, status=operating) is superficially similar (also touches Bobai) but is a different, shorter, already-operating segment with different capacity -- not a duplicate of this 162km under-construction branch. CAVEAT: I could not get any of the four gxzf.gov.cn government-bureau URLs to load from this environment -- every subdomain (fgw., dnr., sthjt., slt.) times out on direct connection AND on an archive.org save/ attempt (which itself returned a 520 after ~90s, suggesting the origin server rejects the crawl, not that archive.org is broken). This reads as a network/geo-block on the whole gxzf.gov.cn family rather than evidence the documents don't exist -- they are indexed by web search with substantive, internally-consistent detail. Per standing rule 2 I have NOT cited them (no verifier pass), but flag this as an access limitation for a future re-check from a China-reachable network, not a red flag on the pipeline itself.

validity.recommendation: Correct StartLocation/StartPrefecture: the true start point is Hepu County (Beihai City), at the Baisha valve room on the existing Sinopec Beihai-LNG export pipeline -- not Bobai County (Yulin).
validity.researcher_notes: The segment's own name -- 'Hepu-Bobai-Pubei Branch Pipeline' (合浦-博白-浦北) -- lists Hepu first, and every government filing title I found (DRC approval, land approval, EIA approval, water permit) is consistently titled '合浦-博白-浦北', i.e. Hepu->Bobai->Pubei. Search-engine-cached DRC approval text is explicit: the Hepu-Bobai branch 'starts from the Baisha valve room of the Sinopec Beihai LNG external transmission pipeline' (in Hepu County, Beihai City) 'and ends at the Bobai distribution station' (Bobai County, Yulin City); the Pubei branch then continues from an intermediate station to Pubei County (Qinzhou City). But the sheet's current fields read StartLocation='Bobai County' / StartPrefecture/District='Yulin' -- i.e. it records the MIDPOINT/end-of-first-branch as the start, and omits Hepu/Beihai (the true origin) entirely. EndLocation='Pubei County'/Qinzhou is correct and unaffected. This is a genuine location error, not just an incompleteness -- worklist already flags this Location cluster 'irregular': true, consistent with a real oddity here. I don't have a verifier-passing URL for the correction (same gxzf.gov.cn access block noted above), so I'm flagging for Update rather than supplying a replacement ref.

validity.researcher_notes: Two smaller, non-blocking discrepancies surfaced while chasing the DRC approval: (1) GEM's ProposalYear=2023 / ProposalMonth=4 sits three years AFTER the project's DRC core approval, which the wiki page's own reference #29 already dates to 2020-06-17 ('广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于...项目核准的批复', approved 2020-06-17). A proposal date normally precedes or coincides with formal approval, so 2023-04 looks too late for this milestone -- it may have been mis-keyed from a different, later approval in the same project family (e.g. the EIA or land-use approval), or from an unrelated adjacent segment. (2) SegmentCost=578,640,000 RMB vs. the ~556,156,000 RMB total-investment figure quoted in the same DRC approval document (55,615.60万元) -- about 4% apart, close enough it may just be a revised/reported estimate rather than an error, but worth a human spot-check. I'm not proposing replacement values (standing rule 2 -- no fabricated refs, and I could not fetch the underlying gxzf.gov.cn document myself), just flagging both for Update's normal source-search.

Searched further for anything newer: found a Feb-2025 procurement-portal notice that a 'Yulin section' detailed-planning public-comment period was underway for this same project (control planning公示, dated ~2025-02-12) -- consistent with an in-progress multi-phase build, not a status change. Also searched specifically for completion/commissioning news ('合博浦'/'合浦-博白-浦北' + 通气/投产/完工) through 2025-2026 and found nothing -- no evidence the line has gone operational, been paused, shelved, or cancelled. The automated existing_ref_check on the sheet's own Sohu ref flagged 'value not found' only because it substring-searches the English word 'construction' against a Chinese-language article -- a known false-negative pattern, not a real problem with the ref. Status=construction stands; last independently confirmable evidence dated Sep 2024, no dormancy concern (well under any 2y/4y staleness threshold and there's a Feb 2025 planning-activity signal on top of it).

summary: P4728 (Hepu-Bobai-Pubei Branch Pipeline) is a real, actively-under-construction 162km transmission branch line -- length/diameter/capacity all closely match an independently-located (but network-unreachable from here) Guangxi DRC approval, and Status=construction is reconfirmed by the sheet's own Sep-2024 Sohu ref plus a Feb-2025 planning-portal signal with no completion/cancellation news since. Two flags for Update: StartLocation/StartPrefecture wrongly records the Bobai midpoint instead of the true Hepu County/Beihai origin (Baisha valve room), and ProposalYear=2023-04 looks inconsistent with the page's own 2020-06-17 DRC-approval citation (SegmentCost also runs ~4% high vs. the approval's investment figure). No duplicate, no misclassification. Seven fields (Length/Diameter/Capacity/SegmentCost/Proposal/Operator/Owner) left UNRESOLVED rather than cited unverifiably -- every candidate source either sits on the network-blocked gxzf.gov.cn domain family or failed url_verifier despite manual confirmation of content.
